{{Quote|Think on this, though&mdash;If we claim to serve the Empire, and Gentis declares the same, which of us is the traitor?''"<br />"''The one who tries to kill the Emperor.''"<br />"''Only if he ''fails'', Lieutenant...|Trachta and Laurita Tohm|<ref name="Darth Vader and the Ghost Prison 3">[[Darth Vader and the Ghost Prison 3|''Darth Vader and the Ghost Prison'' 3]]</ref>}}
The '''mission to the Prism''' occurred in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]] after the rise of the [[New Order/Legends|New Order]] and the subsequent [[Ghost Prison incident|coup]] by [[General/Legends|General]] [[Gentis]]. The coup was an attempt to [[Assassin/Legends|assassinate]] [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]], [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]], and many other Imperials in an attempt to end the tide of senseless [[Death/Legends|deaths]]. Gentis managed to take over [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] by faking terrorist attacks, one of which used the poisonous gas [[Aorth-6]]. This gas wiped out dozens of loyal Imperials and soldiers, and it was only through the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]] that Palpatine managed to survive. Severely weakened, Palpatine was taken by Darth Vader, [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Trachta]], and [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Laurita Tohm]] to the hidden prison known as [[The Prism]] in the Diab system, where they believed they could revive the Emperor. Once there, Tohm devised a plan for retaking the capital by freeing the prisoners of the Prism.

==History==
===Prelude===
{{Quote|The Imperial Crematorium. Each transport carries twenty dead Imperials. In the time that we have been here, nearly one hundred officers and troopers have been reduced to ash.|Gentis|<ref name="Darth Vader and the Ghost Prison 3" />}}
In [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], a few weeks after the rise of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], [[General/Legends|General]] [[Gentis]] attended a military meeting on [[Coruscant/Legends|Imperial Center]]. While seeking to escape the droning of the various [[Moff/Legends|Moffs]], he discovered the [[Imperial Crematorium]], and watched hundreds of dead Imperials be incinerated every minute. Realizing that even though the [[Clone Wars/Legends|war]] had ended, the [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor's]] warmongering ways would never cease, and he quickly set about seeking a way to end the senseless killing.

A few months later, the [[Cadet/Legends|cadets]] of six different academies from around [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] came to the capital in order to be part of the first graduating class of [[Imperial officer/Legends|Imperial officers]]. Gentis, a hero of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], presided over the ceremonies. [[Laurita Tohm]] was the valedictorian of the Raithal Academy, and thus was given the rank of [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] by Gentis himself. Tohm was soon selected to be a part of [[Grand Moff/Legends|Grand Moff]] [[Wilhuff Tarkin/Legends|Wilhuff Tarkin's]] [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]], but Gentis had other plans for the young officer. He ordered [[Ensign/Legends|Ensigns]] [[Caul Gentis]] and [[Shens]] to keep Tohm "out of harm's way". Tohm's friends locked him inside a prototype [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE/LN starfighter]], and for a time, he assumed it was a practical joke. In reality, this was the first small step in Gentis's coup, as he believed that the promising officer would draw too much attention due to his prominence and deformities.

Later that night, explosions rocked the cityscape for [[Kilometer/Legends|kilometers]] around, eliminating seventy-two Imperial targets within minutes. The officer's club, various [[Stormtrooper/Legends|Stormtrooper]] garrisons, the Comm Towers, and a supply depot were all destroyed. [[Imperial Plaza (Imperial Palace)|Imperial Plaza]] became ground zero in the battle that erupted, as "terrorist" forces swarmed through the city streets, fighting with the Empire's [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] forces. The stormtroopers were losing the battle until [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] appeared, rallying the troops and driving the enemy forces back. In the madness, Tohm had escaped from the prototype [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] by engaging its [[Ejector seat/Legends|ejector seat]] and landing in the midst of the battle.

During the battle, Tohm came upon his wounded friend Shens. Shens begged him to kill Vader, but Tohm told his friend that he should have included him earlier, and shot Shens in the head. Tohm then bowed to Vader, who instantly respected his bravery and loyalty. As the pair made their way from the plaza, another explosion tore through the nearby buildings, unleashing a powerful necrotic virus known as [[Aorth-6]]. Dozens of Imperials, including [[Emperor's Royal Guard/Legends|Royal Guardsmen]], were killed by the aerosolized virus, which liquified them from the inside out. Tohm donned a breathing device that he had taken from the TIE fighter when he ejected and followed Vader inside. There they found a mortally infected Palpatine and Moff [[Trachta]]. Palpatine was using the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]] to keep the virus at bay, but was losing the battle even with his formidable powers. Vader accused Trachta of being in league with the conspiracy, but the Moff vehemently denied it, saying they needed to get the Emperor into hiding; fear of his power was the only thing keeping the Empire together. The trio escorted Palpatine to secret [[Hangar/Legends|hangar]] below the [[Imperial Palace/Legends|Imperial Palace]], where they loaded him aboard a stealth transport.

===The Ghost Prison===
{{Quote|There are still many secret places...|Darth Vader|<ref name="Darth Vader and the Ghost Prison 3" />}}
Once safe, Trachta revealed that Gentis had pretended to want to meet the Emperor in order to present his most prized students, but instead unleashed the virus. He then attempted to kill Tohm, saying he didn't trust him, but Vader knocked the [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] from his hand. The three discussed where they could possibly go to hide the Emperor, and Tohm stated that Gentis's influence would likely have overtaken all three Rims. Vader then remembered of a place he had once heard of, but he needed more information, and took Lieutenant Tohm to the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] in order to get it. While they were gone, Gentis's [[Engineer/Legends|engineers]] sent a command to every [[Droid/Legends|droid]] within five kilometers to kill any Imperial officer they saw. Aboard the Emperor's shuttle, Trachta was attacked by a [[2-1B surgical droid/Legends|2-1B surgical droid]], while Vader and Tohm were attacked by [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]]-wielding [[Jedi training droid/Legends|Jedi training droids]].

All three Imperials were victorious, however, and Vader led Tohm into the [[Jedi Council Chamber/Legends|High Council Chamber]] and called up a [[Holorecorder/Legends|holorecording]] of a Jedi Council meeting that Anakin Skywalker had attended. Skywalker demanded to know what happened to the myriad prisoners he had captured over the course of the war, but the Council told him that he was chasing rumors and nothing more. Skywalker persisted, saying that he would get the truth from [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] Palpatine, but [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] calmed him, though Skywalker still left angry. The [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Masters]] further discussed the topic after Skywalker left, revealing that the [[The Prism|secret prison]] was a tightly-kept secret, even from the Chancellor and the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|GAR]]. The Jedi believed that the [[Republic Security Force/Legends|Republic Security Force]] couldn't contain the [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-users]], [[Cyborg/Legends|cyborgs]], [[Changeling/Legends|shape shifters]] and others that they had captured, and that once the war was over, they would then receive fair and open trials. Kenobi was displeased, but obeyed the Council's wishes, still asking that he be allowed to visit the prison himself. [[Master of the Order/Legends|Master of the Order]] [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]] revealed the prison's location and urged Kenobi not to take Anakin. When Kenobi agreed, Vader flew into a [[Force Enrage|rage]], [[Telekinesis/Legends|destroying]] the Council chambers and shouting that the Emperor had been right, that they had been plotting against the two of them from the beginning. He then urged Tohm to remember that the Jedi believed in too many ambiguities, when there was only the Empire, and everyone else.

With their new information, the Imperials left for the [[Diab system/Legends|Diab system]], where the Prism was hidden. Over the course of the three day journey, Tohm attempted to connect with [[The Force/Legends|the Force]], but Trachta discovered this and told him it would be unwise to discover any [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitivity]] at that point. The two then recounted the tales of their mutual disfigurations to one another; Trachta had been attacked by a [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] while Tohm was the victim of a [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] attack that killed his family and maimed him. Trachta then remarked that traitors are only thus if they fail in their mission.

[[File:Prism_Riot.jpg|thumb|right|150px|Darth Vader during the riot]]

Though the Imperials were confronted with a bewildered [[Unidentified Prism Jedi|Jedi Master]] and a force of [[Security droid/Legends|security droids]], Vader cut down the Jedi and all three quickly dealt with the droids. They brought Palpatine to the prison's medical center, where they were able to staunch the disintegration of his body. Tohm then accessed the prison's databank, learning that there were two-hundred and eight prisoners held there, with over half for them arrested by Anakin Skywalker. Vader told Tohm that Skywalker was an impressive Jedi, but that he had killed him, and told Tohm to wipe the system clean. Trachta, however, wanted to find a particular prisoner, and had Tohm help him locate the individual. It turned out that the Padawan who had so terribly disfigured Trachta was imprisoned there, and the cyborg decided to spend several hours beating and torturing him to death.

Knowing that there was no one they could trust to contact, Tohm devised a plan and asked Lord Vader for permission to undertake it: He wished to release all the prisoners of the Prism in order to form an army to take on Gentis.

===Prism riot===
{{Quote|This wasn't war... It was just violence.|[[Laurita Tohm]]|<ref name="Darth Vader and the Ghost Prison 4">[[Darth Vader and the Ghost Prison 4|''Darth Vader and the Ghost Prison'' 4]]</ref>}}
Lacking loyal or trustworthy [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]], Tohm suggested to Vader that the prisoners of the Prism be released and allowed to fight for them, which would allow them to retake [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] from [[General/Legends|General]] [[Gentis]]. Vader amended Tohm's idea, and rather than simply releasing the prisoners, he forced 207 of them to fight one another, as well as Tohm and himself, for the right to serve the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. The battle was vicious and wild, with casualties mounting quickly. Separatist [[Sniper/Legends|sniper]] [[Shonn Volta]] allied herself with Tohm after saving his life from General [[Ur'Loach]], while Vader defeated [[Nax Cirvan]], a [[Dark Jedi/Legends|fallen Jedi]], who then submitted to the Dark Lord.

In the end, only thirty-three prisoners survived in fighting condition, including Volta and Cirvan. Vader ordered Trachta to tell the survivors what it meant to serve the Empire. Trachta told the survivors that their crimes were now forgotten, but their reasons for committing them were not&mdash;they would now serve an institution not beholden to the "selfish" [[Senator/Legends|senators]] of the Republic, nor the Jedi Order. The prisoners knelt before Trachta and the others, becoming Imperials through their submission.
